rule_context: FTC endorsement guidance applies whenever there is a material connection between the brand and the person posting. That includes gifted product, paid partnerships, affiliate links, or any compensation. The disclosure must be clear, conspicuous, and unavoidable in the format the audience actually sees. Hashtags like #ad or #sponsored placed at the beginning or end of the caption satisfy this when they are not buried among other tags. Vague language such as "partner post," "thanks [brand]," or "thanks for the gear" does not meet the standard because it leaves the commercial nature ambiguous. Organic posts with no material connection are out of scope. Employee posts are in scope and must disclose the employment relationship. The test is whether a reasonable viewer would understand the post is advertising without having to click through or read between the lines.
